correctness.rationale: Central symmetry reduces maximum Euclidean inradius to min_{||u||=1} h(u). Szarek sharp Khinchin supplies h(u)>=2^(d-2)||u||/sqrt(2), with equality exactly root-difference unit directions; their facet constraints force all optimal centers onto a diagonal line. On every resonance normal cone h and |sum u| are linear and norm is subadditive, so finite primitive ray testing gives the exact half-length for every d. A fresh enumeration of all primitive normals in d=2,3,4 matches expected radicals, not d>=5; source d=5 certified checker was inspected. Unrestricted proof relies on sharp Khinchin equality theorem.
